id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

targetTypeId.description:
Internal id of C3 type for this invalidation request. Target type depends on the invalidation kind. E.g.
for StoredCalcQueue it's parent type of the field. For MapReduceQueue it's the type of MapReduce job. etc.

targetObjId.description:
Id of C3 obj being invalidated. Target object depends on the invalidation kind. E.g. for StoredCalcQueue
it's the parent object of the field being invalidated. For MapReduceQueue it's the MapReduce job. etc.

lockHashKey.description:
Hash key that uniquely identifies this invalidation request. Used to make sure that only one thread
is handling this invalidation request at a time.

rescheduleKey.description: Key set during reschedule operations to manage queue entry removal.

context.description: Invalidation context. Content of the context depends on invalidation kind.

entryType.description: Used to subclassify entries in a queue (e.g. MapReduceQueueEntry would have "map" or "reduce" indicating which type of entry it is).

priority.description:
Priority of this invalidation entry. Invalidations with lower priority number are processed first. If
priority is set to -1 then these invalidations will be skipped.

nodePool.description:
When non-null, the invalidation queue entry will only be processed by servers with a matching nodePool.
When null, the entry will only be processed by servers with no nodePool.

invalidatedAt.description: Timestamp when invalidation entry was created.

invalidatedNodeId.description: C3 server node id that created this invalidation entry. Useful for debugging.

srcRootActionId.description: Root action id that created this invalidation request. Useful for debugging.

srcActionId.description: Action id that created this invalidation request. Useful for debugging.

srcActionContext.description: Custom context associated with the action that created this invalidation request.

depth.description:
Depth of this invalidation request. Sometime processing of invalidation requests generate downstream
invalidations. This number indicates at which level was this invalidation request created.

lock.description: Lock currently registered in InvalidationQueueLock for the entry's lockHashKey, if any

userToRunAs.description:
The User who the entry should be processed for.  This is only applicable for the {@link ActionQueue},
{@link BatchQueue} and {@link MapReduceQueue}.  It is ignored for all other queues.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings
